notes.title: Major Update 1.7
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

As the head of the [b]One Eleven[/b] project, I want to apologize for the long delay in releasing new content. We have put a lot of effort into shaping the game into what we envisioned, and we truly hope that our work has paid off.

Here’s what awaits you in this patch:

[b]10 new achievements [/b]– for the most dedicated explorers,
[b]15 new timelines[/b] – even more alternative paths,
[b]25 new endings[/b] – your choices matter more than ever,
[b]50 pages of new text [/b]– deeper story details and character development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/d61e95088f4d098292de58624d6fd717f7016d6d.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we’ve addressed some long-standing issues:
[list]
[*] Gallery improvements,
[*] Fixes for logical errors,
[*] Corrections for typos and text inconsistencies,
[*] Game optimization for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support! We’re committed to making [b]One Eleven[/b] even better.

notes.title: UPDATE: 1.6d Patch
Holy Shift is our second project
notes.notes:
[b]Holy Shift release![/b]

Hello everyone!

I am the head of the indie studio [b]Kitten Purradise Studios[/b]. Today we released our second game - the visual novel [b]Holy Shift[/b]. Please love and favor it (or complain).

Link - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056280/Holy_Shift/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056280/Holy_Shift/[/url]

I agree that there is nothing to brag about, but after the not very successful start of the first project, I decided that it was worth trying to make something simpler and easier.

The game turned out to be [b]extremely short[/b], and unlike the budget of [b]One Eleven[/b], the costs for this game were about $500 :D

[list]
[*] $150 - The artist drew the art and all the characters.
[*] $250 - Translation of the entire game into 4 more languages: Japanese, Chinese, English, Spanish.
[*] $0 - programming on Godot Engine. It could have been done on Ren'py, but then the game would have remained without the parallax effect, but I wanted to have something unique in game :P
[*] $100 - is the cost of the game's Steam page.
[/list]

That's how we managed to keep it under $500 he-he

[b][i]What about the game itself?[/i][/b] Well, it's simple: you end up in purgatory with the Succubus, who is in charge there, she will tell you everything (and show you :P).

[i][b]Who might like this?[/b][/i] I think, the person who is tired of constant Romantic Comedies, near-*entai, harems and other 'endless summers'. The game will appeal to psycho-art fans and those who want to know themselves. At the end of the game, you will be given your own characteristics.

Please don't scold me too much :D our team is just looking for itself!

notes.title: Episode 2 and 70% april's discount!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings,[/b]

Today, exactly [b]2 years[/b] have passed since I decided to try my skill at game design. I can’t boast that I achieved anything special, but one game really did come out - [b]One Eleven[/b].
On [b]April 24 in 2023[/b], we launched it on Steam as Early-Access project, and made a [b]full release in November[/b]. I am grateful to everyone who bought and supported the project! Big Thanks to You!

Right now my team is working on the [b]second project Chrono Bullet[/b], as well as the [b]second episode of One Eleven[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2663120/Chrono_Bullet/]Chrono Bullet[/url] is a bullet-hell shooter with city building elements. [b]Wishlist it[/b] if you like such type of games.

So far I have nothing to show about it, except some pictures and sketches:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/6bcd66940f15053df5d03d1c8937d510c0033528.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/1c33a186d91cba6a453ffd216aae4680fe3a3f7e.jpg[/img]

[b]Episode Two - One Eleven[/b] is almost ready, I’m sharing the progress and results:

[b]Sprites[/b] (characters): [b]95%[/b] (some edition still need)
[b]Backgrounds[/b]: [b]90%[/b] (2 unfinished backdrops for mini games)
[b]Arts[/b]: [b]70%[/b] (18+ scenes still missing)
[b]Music[/b] (OST): [b]100%[/b] (7 more new tracks await you)
[b]Text[/b]: [b]100%[/b] (proofreading is underway now (if you want, you can participate, I can give the text for those who like to look for typos))
[b]Text translation[/b]: [b]90%[/b] (we also haven’t looked for typos yet)
[b]Programming[/b]: [b]5%[/b] (biggest problem here)
[b]Voice acting[/b]: [b]5%[/b] (only NPCs overvoiced)
[b]Steam[/b]: [b]100%[/b] ready (always ready)

The release is scheduled for [b]autumn 2024[/b] (but this is not certain).

Here is some teasers from Episode 2:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/05f1c4cdbc70fbffd9df6d6514d5566ce73dd890.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/fb6d7ef814caeca1166baade7432f37b3838da16.jpg[/img]

So what problem was I talking about? The fact is that the [b]first episode[/b] did not receive the success it deserved (in my opinion :D), and now it is not clear where the money for the second episode will come from.
 
I will try [b]to find funds[/b], but I will be very grateful if you advertise this project to your friends who have not played yet, or [b]support us on the Steam page through Reviews[/b] - they help promote the project in the Steam ranking and then it will advertise us!

Thanks again everyone! We're working!

Join our team at [url=https://discord.gg/ZG6EdSASBG]discord[/url]

notes.title: One Eleven on a Spring Sales from 14 to 21 march
notes.notes:
Greetings to all,
To both those who have already played our project[b] One Eleven[/b], and those who are just about to do so. 

I am the head of the project and would like to talk to you honestly. For me and my team, this is the first game, and as everybody says in such cases "the first is a bit of a mess".
Unfortunately, this happened to us too. We didn’t fix all the bugs right away, we couldn’t release some scenes right away, we couldn’t find our audience.
But everything has both a bad and a good side. In this particular case -> [b]experience[/b] is good. Experience that will help us make the second chapter of One Eleven better and faster. 
This indescribable experience will also help us with [b]Chrono Bullet[/b] project, the alpha version of which we will soon show on YouTube and begin distributing invitation keys for testing.

In general, I wanted to write in this post about that we have a difficult situation and we don’t have enough money for all the ideas, and it would be great if people bought One Eleven game. But I am not a beggar, but a man of action and therefore I will say this.

If you leave [b]reviews and comments[/b], I will know that you need it and then I will find the money so that all the planned projects will be published. And I promise to you, that those projects will turn this indie world upside down (he-he).
